tagline.en: A memory-augmented world model that stitches remembered views into a consistent, explorable scene.
tagline.zh: 一个记忆增强的世界模型，把记住的多个视角拼合成一致、可探索的场景。

en: MosaicMem is an open-source memory-augmented world model for video generation. Its central idea is memory: it ingests keyframe patches, retrieves the views relevant to where you want to look next, and composes them on a shared latent canvas so the generated world stays coherent over time.

This memory-first design targets a common weakness of pure video models — drift and forgetting. By keeping a growing record of what has already been seen and pulling from it during generation, MosaicMem aims for spatial consistency as the viewpoint moves.

In WorldFoundry, MosaicMem is available through the memory layer, which handles keyframe patch ingestion, target-view retrieval, coverage summaries, and latent-canvas composition. The generator weights and assets are supplied separately before you produce output.
zh: MosaicMem 是一个开源的记忆增强世界模型，面向视频生成。它的核心是「记忆」：吸收关键帧的图块，检索出与你下一步想看的方向相关的视角，并在一个共享的 latent canvas 上进行合成，使生成的世界随时间保持连贯。
这种以记忆为先的设计针对纯视频模型的常见短板——漂移与遗忘。通过不断累积已经看过的内容、并在生成时从中取用，MosaicMem 力求在视角移动时保持空间一致性。
在 WorldFoundry 中，MosaicMem 通过记忆层提供：负责关键帧图块的吸收、目标视角检索、覆盖度汇总，以及 latent canvas 合成。生成器权重与资源需在产出前单独准备。

whenToUse.en: Consider MosaicMem when spatial consistency across a moving viewpoint matters — building an explorable scene where previously-seen regions should stay stable rather than being re-hallucinated.
whenToUse.zh: 当移动视角下的空间一致性很重要时，可以考虑 MosaicMem——比如构建一个可探索的场景，让此前看过的区域保持稳定，而不是被重新臆造。

notFor.en: Not the simplest path to a one-off short clip — the memory workflow is aimed at consistent, explorable worlds. Generator weights and assets are obtained separately.
notFor.zh: 如果只想生成一段一次性的短片，它并非最简单的路径——记忆化流程更适合追求一致、可探索的世界。生成器权重与资源需单独获取。

en: Memory-augmented generation for spatial consistency over time
Keyframe patch ingestion plus target-view retrieval
zh: 记忆增强生成，追求随时间的空间一致性
关键帧图块吸收 + 目标视角检索
在 latent canvas 上合成记住的视角
通过 WorldFoundry 的记忆层对外提供
